name: MicroC 3D
description: MicroC on a 3D cube: 750x750x750 um domain, 15x15x15 PDE voxels, 20 um cells (37^3 bio sites), seeded with a 500-cell Euclidean-ball spheroid (initial_cells_3d_500_center_750.csv). Same biology as the 2D p53 experiment (split metabolic + growth-factor solvers, NetLogo-aligned necrosis with the gene AND environment double gate, fate-weighted metabolism, necrotic decay) - only the geometry and the plotting node differ: iteration_plots uses generate_3d_plots, which renders quadrant-style figures of configurable slice planes (default the three mid-planes) and writes an interactive Plotly 3D viewer HTML every 10 iterations (cells with metabolism/fate as toggleable views, substances as threshold isosurfaces). Planner arms: p53on/p53off gene clamps as in the 2D experiment.

__world__.description: MicroC: __world__ (sets up the world: simulation, domain, the empty population container bound to the domain grid, substances, associations)

functions.description: Initialize simulation infrastructure
Define 3D spatial domain (750 um cube, 15^3 voxels)
Create the (empty) cell population container bound to the domain grid. Cells are placed later by the agent init (read_checkpoint).
Configure all substance-to-gene associations

Marks gene inputs as PROBABILISTIC (NetLogo hill drug law) instead of the deterministic conc > threshold test: p = hill_max - hill_max/(1 + (conc/threshold)^hill_exponent); the input turns ON if p exceeds the cell's persistent random (drawn at creation, re-drawn at division). The threshold is the input's row in the Associations dict above — not repeated here. Inputs not listed stay deterministic. Consumed each step by apply_associations_to_inputs and at t=0 by the gene-network init.
Metabolism model constants (Michaelis-Menten laws used by the coupled diffusion solver). Equations documented in the node source.

tumor_cell_create.description: MicroC: tumor_cell_create (seeds the tumor_cell agents into the world: load cells from checkpoint, then build per-cell gene networks)

functions.description: Read checkpoint file with cell positions and gene states. If gene states are present, initializes them.
Initialize NetLogo-faithful gene networks for all cells
Clamp genes for the whole run (heritable across division). p53 OFF = tumour.
Wrap the loaded cells in an abm_population so MicroC runs on the ABM motor

diffusion_step.description: MicroC diffusion (SPECIAL CASE): two collective solves advance all substance fields each step -- a Picard-coupled Michaelis-Menten solve of the metabolic group (Oxygen, Glucose, Lactate, H) and a single implicit solve of the growth factors (TGFA, FGF, HGF, GI). Each solve spans several substances at once, so no single substance owns it -- deliberately homed as a World behavior, not per-resource, which is why the resource_kinds intentionally carry empty behaviors.

functions.description: MicroC metabolic model — per-cell O2/glucose consumption and lactate/proton production. The solver calls this once per coupling iteration.

COUPLED solver - iterative coupling with under-relaxation, all 8 substances in one loop. Disabled: growth-factor uptake is evaluated explicitly here, which makes the zero-flux TGFA/FGF/GI steady states singular (fields freeze at 0 or land on an arbitrary constant). Replaced by the split Metabolic + Growth Factor solver nodes below.

METABOLIC solve: Picard-coupled steady state of Oxygen/Glucose/Lactate/H with Michaelis-Menten cell metabolism. Growth factors are excluded — they are linear and handled by the Growth Factor Solver node below in a single implicit pass.

GROWTH FACTOR solve: TGFA/FGF/HGF/GI with per-cell production γ_P where the substance's gene node is ON and first-order uptake γ_C·C folded into the PDE matrix as an implicit sink (∇·(D∇C) − k·C = −P). Linear given the gene states, so one direct solve — no coupling iterations. Rates come from each substance's uptake_rate/production_rate in its Resources configuration.

iteration_plots.description: MicroC 3D: iteration_plots (sliced quadrant figures + interactive 3D viewer, via generate_3d_plots)

functions.description: Per-substance AutoPlotter heatmaps (mid-z slice in 3D). Disabled: superseded by generate_3d_plots.

3D plots: quadrant-style figures of the configured slice planes (cells of the slab's central bio layer, metabolic interiors + fate borders, threshold isolines) and an interactive Plotly viewer HTML every html_interval iterations (metabolism/fate as toggleable views, substances as threshold isosurfaces).

Save replayable state next to the plots (fields as npz; cells, thresholds, geometry and time as json). Keeps the latest 10 complete checkpoint pairs; set max_checkpoints to 0 only when every iteration must remain replayable offline.
Translate substance concentrations → gene input states via associations
NetLogo single-gene random update (matches gene_network_standalone.py); honours gene clamps
Advance each cell's age by one scheduler step. Age counts steps since the cell last divided (division resets it to 0), and feeds the cell_cycle_time gate below.
Mark cells as necrotic based on user-defined conditions
Track cells in Growth_Arrest state with time limit
Mark cells as apoptotic based on gene network Apoptosis output

Mark cells as Proliferation only if the Proliferation gene is ON, atp_rate > atp_threshold1 x atp_rate_max, and age > cell_cycle_time steps. Everything else that is not already Apoptosis/Growth_Arrest resets to Quiescence.
Handle cell division for proliferating cells
Remove cells with Apoptosis phenotype from population
Remove cells that have stayed necrotic for necrosis_removal_delay scheduler steps

Generate final state visualization. Every heatmap overlay is switchable: show_cells, show_metabolism_colors (interior colouring), show_fate_colors (border colouring), show_isolines (threshold lines), show_legends (cell-colour key), show_info_box (details box).

symbiosis_summary.description: MicroC: symbiosis_summary (per-iteration CSV for the metabolic-symbiosis figures -- cells by ATP pathway, cells by oxygen region, and the metabolic symbiosis index)

functions.description: One CSV row per iteration: cells by ATP pathway (glycoATP / mitoATP / total), cells by oxygen region (oxygenated / hypoxic), and the metabolic symbiosis index. MSI is emitted twice because 'lactate metabolic' has two defensible readings in jaya.bnd: msi_mct1 counts only cells importing lactate (MCT1 ON), msi_mito counts any oxidative cell (mitoATP ON, which includes glucose-fed ones).

subworkflow_calls.description: symbiosis_summary (placed before division, so the census matches the fates just marked). Must NOT carry for_each: record_metabolic_symbiosis is a whole-population reporter that writes one row per iteration.

iteration_plots (before division, like fate_summary: division consumes the marked fates - remove_apoptotic_cells deletes Apoptosis cells and update_cell_division resets divided cells to Quiescent - so plotting after it would show every border as quiescent)

fate_summary (before division, so marked phenotypes are still visible). Must NOT carry for_each. With kind: tumor_cell it does not run at all -- MicroC deliberately leaves metabolic_state['_kind'] untagged (see build_tumor_cell_abm_population), so agents_of_kind('tumor_cell') is empty and the log reads "Running 'fate_summary' over 0 tumor_cell(s)". A kind-less per-agent ask is no better: record_gene_fate_counts is a whole-population reporter with no env.cell guard, so it would write one duplicate census row per cell and zero out the fires/reverts deltas.
